dedupe_keys.name: construction materials tests for federal roads and buildings

description: Construction Materials Tests for Federal Roads and Buildings is a dataset listed in Ajmandata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ministry of Energy & Infrastructure. Tests done on construction materials that are used in the construction of federal roads projects and federal buildings projects with its price and Frequency and the number of tests done per each year in each emirate. Coverage: Ajman emirate. The portal files it under Transport and infrastructure, Other. Its keywords are Construction Material. The portal shows 176 records. The portal shows 2024-07-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ajman-ae-portal.
